title: Cupholders and longer-trip usability
summary: The topic mostly contains cupholder and convenience comments, but the sample also includes an unrelated longer-trip interface remark, so the feedback is not fully coherent.

positive.summary: One positive review praises easier door access because the occupant no longer has to lean out to grab and shut the door.

negative.summary: One negative review objects to the cupholders being placed beside the phone tray because a spilled drink could affect the tray area.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention a wish for heated and cooled cupholders, undersized cupholders, and a longer-trip interface preference without clear evaluative labeling for the topic overall.

limitations: The sample is very small and several reviews are undetermined, limiting clear interpretation.
The cluster mixes cupholder feedback with an unrelated longer-trip interface comment, so it is not fully topic-pure.
Some undetermined fragments describe preferences or attributes without enough context to classify clear sentiment beyond the provided labels.
